# Notifications and Operator UX Checklist: SPEC-005 ready_for_owner State and Two-Step Terminal Event

**Purpose**: Validate notification and operator-facing UX requirement quality for SPEC-005 before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-05-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are `task_ready_for_owner` notification requirements complete for both normal ready-for-owner entry and reconciliation-required cases? [Completeness, Spec §US5, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK002 Are recipient-routing requirements complete by naming assignee-first delivery and creator fallback for normal and reconciliation notifications? [Completeness, Spec §US5, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Operator Surfaces]
- [ ] CHK003 Are notification source requirements complete for reconciliation cases by specifying `source_type="task"` and `source_id=<task id>`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 Are Kanban lane requirements complete for key, display label, teal styling, and placement between `quality_review` and `done`? [Completeness, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK005 Are accessibility requirements specified for keyboard, focus, and screen-reader identification on the new `ready_for_owner` Kanban lane and action-required notifications? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019a, Constitution §XIV]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the normal notification title specified exactly as `Ready for owner merge`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the reconciliation notification title specified exactly as `Owner merge reconciliation required`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the required action phrase specified exactly as `Owner action required` for message and delivery copy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Operator Surfaces]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the `Ready for Owner` lane label capitalized and scoped clearly enough to avoid drift from the `ready_for_owner` status key? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK010 Is teal styling specified with enough precision to align the Kanban lane and GitHub label family without implying a new design system? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-019]
